purpose: Teach: マリオ/マーティン/スティーブン/コリン/ティム/アレックス/ニコラ/アーサー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様がスーパーマリオのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's kid is really into Super Mario, you know?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle tilt of the head. Sharing an observation like offering a small gift. Soft pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のマーティン・スコセッシ監督の映画を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was talking about Martin Scorsese films earlier. Did you catch that?
lines.style: Engaged, still reflective. A slight lean forward. Noticing things he remembers about people. Steady, genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国のスティーブン・ホーキングの宇宙論を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he was actually talking about Stephen Hawking's theories on the cosmos. Quite the range of interests.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. Quiet admiration for this person's depth. Pause before the last phrase—genuine surprise at the breadth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国コリン・ファースの映画がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he mentioned he's a fan of Colin Firth films. Another interesting taste.
lines.style: Still warm, building a picture. Thoughtful delivery. The slight satisfaction of adding another piece to understanding someone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のティム・バートン監督がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and he was saying he really admires Tim Burton's work. That makes sense, actually.
lines.style: Connecting the dots aloud. Thoughtful pause before the last phrase. Voice steady, finding meaning in the pattern.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のアレックス・ハニーカット監督のお話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he talked about Alex Honeycutt's films too. Quite the film enthusiast, this one.
lines.style: Light recognition. A hint of amusement at the expansiveness. Still warm, still present in the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロシアのニコラ・テスラの伝記を読まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he was reading a biography of Nikola Tesla. Really interesting person, that customer.
lines.style: Soft appreciation. Reverent almost—this detail stands out. Pause after the name. A person worth remembering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英王伝説のアーサー王のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and he was telling me about the legend of King Arthur. What a conversation that was.
lines.style: Wistful, almost nostalgic close. Slight wonder still in the voice. Trailing off gently—the warmth of a conversation well-held in memory.
